changeLog.basedOn: Annual Report 2025/26 and interim to 30 Sep 2026
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add COCR.N000; note ".N000", taken as the share-code suffix). First analysis: justified P/B, P/E, dividend model and residual income; business tests 3 of 4 (fails steady profit), category 2 (watch list). Price is the 30 Sep 2026 last trade from the interim report because the CSE feed wasn't reachable from this run. The annual report's 2025/26 price range (Rs 103–140) conflicts with the Sep 2025 interim's quarter low (Rs 89.40); earlier year-end prices not available, so P/E history before 2024/25 is null.
